text: A planar four-bar linkage connects four rigid links in a closed loop, one fixed as the frame. The joint geometry constrains how the remaining links move.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Robert L. Williams II, Ohio University, ME 3011 Kinematics and Dynamics of Machines notes; https://people.ohio.edu/williams/html/PDF/NotesBook3011.pdf. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: A crank-rocker linkage combines an input capable of full rotation with an output that swings through a limited arc.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Robert L. Williams II, Ohio University, ME 3011 Kinematics and Dynamics of Machines notes; https://people.ohio.edu/williams/html/PDF/NotesBook3011.pdf. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: In a double-rocker four-bar mechanism, both links attached to the frame have limited angular travel.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Robert L. Williams II, Ohio University, ME 3011 Kinematics and Dynamics of Machines notes; https://people.ohio.edu/williams/html/PDF/NotesBook3011.pdf. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: For a four-bar loop, compare the shortest-plus-longest link lengths with the other two lengths. Grashof's test helps classify which links can make complete rotations.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Robert L. Williams II, Ohio University, ME 3011 Kinematics and Dynamics of Machines notes; https://people.ohio.edu/williams/html/PDF/NotesBook3011.pdf. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: A four-bar linkage at the equality case of Grashof's condition can reach a collinear configuration where it may change assembly branch.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Robert L. Williams II, Ohio University, ME 3011 Kinematics and Dynamics of Machines notes; https://people.ohio.edu/williams/html/PDF/NotesBook3011.pdf. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: Fixing a different link in the same linkage changes the mechanism's motion while retaining the link lengths and joint connections.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Robert L. Williams II, Ohio University, ME 3011 Kinematics and Dynamics of Machines notes; https://people.ohio.edu/williams/html/PDF/NotesBook3011.pdf. Consulted 2026-10-13.
